facts.fact: 两个月后的 Cassie：新染的火红长发——从「勉强十分」升到「扎实十五分」。
facts.anchor: With thick, freshly dyed flaming red hair, secured in a scrunchie at the nape of her neck, paired with her peely-wally skin and chocolatey eyes, Cassie Torrance has gone from a close ten to a solid fifteen.

facts.fact: Blair 的联合疗法：熏香冥想与吃药看病，两者可以并行。
facts.anchor: I think you can light your smelly sticks and meditate, and I also think you can accept help and medicate.

facts.fact: 求医的死结：谋杀的事永远开不了口。
facts.anchor: Hi, Doctor, I murdered a man, and now I can’t sleep. Can you help? A huge nope.

facts.fact: 处方单是 Blair 替她接下的——她哭着说吃药会让她「看起来像疯子」。
facts.anchor: I saw how reluctant she was to accept, so I did it for her, grabbing the pink slip, and then her hand.

facts.fact: 房间翻新：那张大桌被布置成「圣龛」——新买的水晶、牌与书一一陈列。
facts.anchor: I even displayed all her newly purchased coloured rocks and cards and books on it like a shrine.

facts.fact: Blair 的三班倒：装修、新酒吧夜班、写那本「该死的书」。
facts.anchor: Between doing this, working in the new bar at night, and finding time to write this bloody book

facts.fact: 炸弹：Cassie 承认读过那本日记、一直藏在身边没说。
facts.anchor: ‘I read it – your journal, I mean. Back at the flat. And the thing is, I still have it.

facts.fact: 反转：Blair 根本不知道日记的存在——她的「书」里只有两个字：TITLE UNKNOWN。
facts.anchor: There’re only two words in it too: TITLE UNKNOWN.
